stage.label: Private pilot in preparation
stage.copy: Impact Gate is being prepared for a small private pilot.

warnOnly.label: Warn-only
warnOnly.copy: Impact Gate posts review information and does not block a merge.

mechanism.label: Contract diff to evidence
mechanism.copy: It compares an OpenAPI change with connected consumer code and shows engineers the evidence behind potential impact.

policy.label: Uncertainty is visible
policy.copy: When the connected code does not give a clear answer, the result stays uncertain instead of being treated as no impact.

contract.label: OpenAPI contract changes
contract.copy: Review supported changes to an OpenAPI contract against connected consumer code.
changes: Endpoint or path changes
Added, removed, or renamed routes that can change how consumers reach an API.
Request and response types
Schema changes that alter the shape consumers send or receive.
Required fields
New required inputs that existing callers may not provide.
Optionality changes
Fields becoming optional or required, changing the assumptions callers can make.
Field removal or rename
Removed or renamed fields that consumer code may still read.
Enum changes
Added, removed, or renamed contract values that need review in callers.
Nullability changes
Values changing between nullable and non-nullable states.
Format and constraints
Changes to formats, ranges, lengths, or other declared value constraints.
Parameter changes
Path, query, header, or cookie parameters that change a request contract.
Status changes
Documented response status changes that alter client handling.
Request body changes
Changed payload requirements or content types for submitted data.
Response body changes
Changed payload requirements or content types for returned data.

manyMore.title: More OpenAPI changes are supported.
manyMore.copy: Use the coverage guide for the complete list.

analysis.label: Static consumer tracing
analysis.copy: Consumer tracing is being prepared for a private pilot and should be reviewed with the limits of the connected codebase in mind.

model.label: Optional model assistance
model.copy: Optional model assistance is not required for the deterministic core and is not part of the default site promise.
